21/G.goal: Explain how augmented reality software tools are organized by developer skill, target platform, or tracking technology and distinguish low-level libraries and frameworks from rapid-prototyping authoring tools with representative examples.
21/G.achieves: Prepares the learner to reason about AR software choices in the later design and implementation stages of building an XR system.

21/O1.goal: Describe the augmented reality software tool landscape, organizing tools by developer skill, target platform, or tracking technology and identifying representative low-level and rapid-prototyping tools.
21/O1.achieves: Gives the learner a foundation for identifying relevant AR software options when planning an XR application, supporting the course aim of understanding and implementing XR systems with confidence.
